name: tooltip-provider

name: cn-tooltip-arrow

name: scroll-area-scrollbar

name: sidebar-peek-strip

name: cn-sidebar-peek-strip

name: cn-sidebar-shortcut

reason: Web-first chat composer uses DOM text editing, file drop/paste and voice-glow. Native composition, attachment picking and voice visuals are deferred.

name: color-picker

name: file-tree

name: model-picker

name: number-field

name: time-input
reason: Web-first time field and duration modes use Time Wheel. Native field and wheel controls are deferred; the native Date Picker documents this limit.

name: time-wheel
reason: Web-first wheel is a Time Input and Date Picker part. Native touch scrolling, snapping and accessibility adjustments are deferred with Time Input.
